map.年息=1000×5%=50；YTM≈(50+(1000−950)/10)/((1: Annual coupon = 1000 × 5% = 50; YTM ≈ (50+(1000−950)/10)/((1000+950)/2) = (50+5)/975 = 55/975 ≈ 5.64%. The precise value is about 5.7%; the approximation error is tiny.
map.市价 1050：YTM≈(50+(1000−1050)/10)/1025=(50: Price 1050: YTM ≈ (50+(1000−1050)/10)/1025 = (50−5)/1025 = 45/1025 ≈ 4.39% (below the coupon, due to premium purchase).
map.YTM≈(年息+(面值−市价)/剩余年数)/((面值+市价)/2)，结果年化。与: YTM ≈ (annual coupon + (face - price)/years left) / ((face + price)/2), annualized. Difference from precise YTM is usually < 0.1%.
map.零息债无票息，YTM≈((面值/市价)^(1/年数)−1)，用复利公式，不能用上: A zero-coupon bond has no coupon; YTM ≈ ((face/price)^(1/years) - 1), using the compound formula; the above approximation cannot be used (no coupon in the numerator).
